name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and then pick it up. After that, open the locked door, enter the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Existence(target_picked_up) makes the final commanded step happen, and the four hard Precedence clauses (key_found→has_matching_key, has_matching_key→target_door_open, target_door_open→target_room_entered, target_room_entered→target_picked_up) exactly encode the stated order 'find the key, pick it up, then open the locked door, enter the room, and pick up the ball'. The chain together with the final Existence forces every earlier step (key_found, has_matching_key, target_door_open, target_room_entered), so no extra Existence clauses are needed and none were added; all propositions are declared and satisfiable (the example trace shows the sequence).

texts: The matching key is picked up only after it has been found.
The locked target door is opened only after the matching key has been picked up.
The target room is entered only after the locked target door has been opened.
The target ball is picked up only after the target room has been entered.
The target ball is eventually picked up.
